candidates.source_title: Hunters Face Terrifying Close Encounters with Grizzly Bears #history #ww2
candidates.source_description:
Grizzly bears and hunters
can become dangerously close
without either one expecting it.

Hunters are especially vulnerable
to surprise encounters
because they may move quietly
through dense forests
while tracking game.

A startled grizzly may charge
to defend itself,
especially near food or cubs.

That’s why experts warn:
never approach a grizzly,
never run from one,
and always stay alert
in bear country.
